column1: # 原创就诊、护理与医患沟通用语；不提供诊断或用药建议。
# 每行：词头、英文句1、中文句1、英文句2、中文句2。

column2: The patient is waiting outside.
column4: Please check the patient's name first.
column5: 请先核对患者姓名。

column2: I'd like to see a doctor.
column4: The doctor will explain the results.
column5: 医生会解释检查结果。

column2: Could you call the nurse, please?
column3: 麻烦你叫一下护士好吗？
column4: The nurse asked about my allergies.
column5: 护士询问了我的过敏情况。

column2: Which hospital should I go to?
column4: My father is still in hospital.
column5: 我父亲还在住院。

column2: What time does the clinic open?
column4: I'll meet you outside the clinic.
column5: 我在诊所外面等你。

column2: I'd like to book an appointment.
column4: Can I change my appointment to Friday?
column5: 能把我的预约改到周五吗？

column2: Could you explain the diagnosis?
column3: 能解释一下这个诊断吗？
column4: We are still waiting for a diagnosis.
column5: 我们还在等待诊断结果。

column2: When did this symptom start?
column3: 这个症状是什么时候开始的？
column4: Please describe each symptom clearly.
column5: 请把每个症状描述清楚。

column2: What does the treatment involve?
column3: 这个治疗包括哪些内容？
column4: I'd like to discuss my treatment options.
column5: 我想讨论一下可选的治疗方案。

column2: Should I bring my medicine with me?
column4: What is this medicine called?
column5: 这个药叫什么名字？

column2: Are you taking any medication?
column4: I've brought a list of my medication.
column5: 我带来了我的用药清单。

column2: Can you explain this prescription?
column3: 能解释一下这张处方吗？
column4: I left my prescription at home.
column5: 我把处方落在家里了。

column2: Could you confirm the dosage?
column3: 能帮我确认一下剂量吗？
column4: The dosage is written on the label.
column5: 剂量写在标签上。

column2: Is there a pharmacy nearby?
column4: The pharmacy closes at six.
column5: 药房六点关门。

column2: When is the surgery scheduled?
column4: Please explain the risks of surgery.
column5: 请解释一下手术风险。

column2: Where is the emergency department?
column4: This is a medical emergency.
column5: 这是医疗急症。

column2: Please call an ambulance.
column4: The ambulance has arrived.
column5: 救护车到了。

column2: How will you check for an infection?
column3: 你们会怎样检查是否有感染？
column4: The report mentions an infection.
column5: 报告里提到了感染。

column2: Which virus does the test look for?
column3: 这个检查检测哪种病毒？
column4: The doctor explained how the virus spreads.
column5: 医生解释了这种病毒是如何传播的。

column2: Which vaccine is this?
column4: I'd like some information about the vaccine.
column5: 我想了解一下这个疫苗。

column2: Can I book a vaccination appointment?
column3: 我可以预约接种疫苗吗？
column4: Please bring your vaccination record.
column5: 请带上你的疫苗接种记录。

column2: Is this disease contagious?
column4: The leaflet explains the disease in plain language.
column5: 这份说明单用通俗的话解释了这个病。

column2: Has your condition changed since yesterday?
column3: 和昨天相比，你的病情有变化吗？
column4: Please tell us about any existing medical condition.
column5: 请告诉我们你已有的疾病情况。

column2: Do I need a blood test?
column4: When will the blood test results be ready?
column5: 验血结果什么时候出来？

column2: Could you check my blood pressure?
column4: The nurse recorded my blood pressure.
column5: 护士记录了我的血压。

column2: My heart is beating very fast.
column4: The doctor listened to my heart.
column5: 医生听诊了我的心脏。

column2: What does the lung scan show?
column4: I'd like to understand the lung test results.
column5: 我想了解肺部检查结果。

column2: Where do you feel the pain?
column4: The pain started this morning.
column5: 疼痛是今天早上开始的。

column2: I've had a fever since last night.
column4: Did you have a fever at home?
column5: 你在家时发烧了吗？

column2: Do you have a medicine allergy?
column4: My allergy information is on this card.
column5: 我的过敏信息在这张卡上。

column2: What should I expect during recovery?
column3: 康复期间可能会有哪些情况？
column4: I'd like to discuss my recovery plan.
column5: 我想讨论一下我的康复计划。

column2: How long does each therapy session last?
column3: 每次治疗持续多长时间？
column4: Can you explain how this therapy works?
column5: 能解释一下这种疗法吗？

column2: I'd like to discuss my health concerns.
column3: 我想谈谈我担心的健康问题。
column4: The form asks about my health history.
column5: 这张表询问了我的健康史。

column2: Do you accept this insurance?
column4: I'll check with my insurance provider.
column5: 我会向保险公司确认。

column2: I've brought my medical records.
column4: Could I have a copy of the medical report?
column5: 我能拿一份医疗报告副本吗？

column2: Please check my vaccination record.
column3: 请查看我的疫苗接种记录。
column4: Can you update my medical record?
column5: 能更新一下我的病历吗？

column2: What happens during the examination?
column4: Can someone accompany me during the examination?
column5: 检查时可以有人陪我吗？

column2: When will I get the test results?
column3: 我什么时候能拿到检查结果？
column4: Do I need to prepare for this test?
column5: 这项检查需要做准备吗？

column2: How long will the scan take?
column4: Could you explain the scan results?
column5: 能解释一下扫描结果吗？

column2: Where is the laboratory?
column4: The sample has been sent to the laboratory.
column5: 样本已经送到检验室了。

column2: Where can I learn more about disease prevention?
column3: 我可以在哪里了解更多疾病预防知识？
column4: The clinic has a leaflet about prevention.
column5: 诊所有一份关于预防的说明单。

column2: I'd like some advice about nutrition.
column3: 我想咨询一下营养方面的问题。
column4: Can I speak to someone about nutrition?
column5: 我可以找人咨询营养问题吗？

column2: I'd like to talk about my mental health.
column3: 我想谈谈我的心理健康。
column4: The clinic offers mental health support.
column5: 这家诊所提供心理健康支持。

column2: I've booked a physical examination.
column4: The form asks about physical activity.
column5: 这张表询问了身体活动情况。

column2: Do I need to see a specialist?
column4: I've made an appointment with a specialist.
column5: 我已经预约了专科医生。

column2: How long is the consultation?
column4: Can I bring an interpreter to the consultation?
column5: 问诊时我可以带口译员吗？

column2: How do I access healthcare here?
column3: 在这里怎样获得医疗服务？
column4: I'm looking for a local healthcare provider.
column5: 我在找本地的医疗服务机构。

column2: The hospital has a diagnostics department.
column4: Can you explain what diagnostics are available?
column5: 能说明一下有哪些诊断检查吗？

column2: Will you need to hospitalize me?
column4: The team decided to hospitalize the patient.
column5: 医疗团队决定收治这位患者入院。

column2: How long might hospitalization last?
column4: Does my insurance cover hospitalization?
column5: 我的保险涵盖住院费用吗？

column2: Can I ask about this herbal remedy?
column3: 我可以咨询一下这种草药疗法吗？
column4: I haven't tried this remedy before.
column5: 我之前没有试过这种疗法。

column2: Where is the psychiatry department?
column4: My appointment is with the psychiatry team.
column5: 我预约的是精神科团队。

column2: I'll wait outside the infirmary.
column4: The school infirmary is open today.
column5: 学校医务室今天开放。

column2: When did the illness begin?
column3: 这个病是什么时候开始的？
column4: I missed work because of illness.
column5: 我因为生病没去上班。

column2: I've been feeling sick all morning.
column3: 我整个上午都觉得不舒服。
column4: My child is sick today.
column5: 我的孩子今天生病了。

column2: I get motion sickness on buses.
column4: The form asks about recent sickness.
column5: 这张表询问了近期生病的情况。

column2: I've had a headache all day.
column4: When did your headache start?
column5: 你什么时候开始头疼的？

column2: I've had this cough for a week.
column4: Does the cough keep you awake?
column5: 咳嗽会让你睡不着吗？

column2: I think I've caught a cold.
column4: How long have you had this cold?
column5: 你这次感冒多久了？

column2: Is there a test for flu?
column4: I'd like to ask about the flu vaccine.
column5: 我想咨询流感疫苗。

column2: When did the nausea start?
column3: 恶心是什么时候开始的？
column4: I've been having nausea after meals.
column5: 我饭后会觉得恶心。

column2: Does the dizziness come and go?
column3: 你的头晕是时有时无吗？
column4: I felt dizziness when I stood up.
column5: 我站起来时感到头晕。

column2: How did the injury happen?
column4: I've brought the report about my injury.
column5: 我带来了有关这次受伤的报告。

column2: Does the scan show a fracture?
column4: The report mentions a wrist fracture.
column5: 报告提到了腕部骨折。

column2: Can someone look at this burn?
column3: 能请人看看这处烧伤吗？
column4: When did you get the burn?
column5: 你什么时候烧伤的？

column2: When did the bleeding start?
column3: 是什么时候开始出血的？
column4: The nurse asked about the bleeding.
column5: 护士询问了出血的情况。

column2: Could you check my pulse?
column4: The nurse recorded my pulse.
column5: 护士记录了我的脉搏。

column2: My heartbeat feels irregular.
column4: The monitor records the heartbeat.
column5: 监护仪记录心跳。

column2: I feel short of breath.
column4: The doctor asked me to take a deep breath.
column5: 医生让我深呼吸。

column2: I have a history of asthma.
column4: I'd like to discuss my asthma symptoms.
column5: 我想谈谈我的哮喘症状。

column2: I have diabetes.
column4: I've brought my diabetes care record.
column5: 我带来了我的糖尿病诊疗记录。

column2: The report says I have hypertension.
column4: Can you explain what hypertension means?
column5: 能解释一下高血压是什么意思吗？

column2: I'd like to ask about cancer screening.
column4: The hospital has a cancer support service.
column5: 这家医院有癌症支持服务。

column2: What does the report say about the tumor?
column3: 报告对这个肿瘤是怎么说的？
column4: I'd like more information about this tumor.
column5: 我想进一步了解这个肿瘤。

column2: Where is the oncology department?
column4: My next appointment is with the oncology team.
column5: 我下次预约的是肿瘤科团队。

column2: What happens during chemotherapy?
column3: 化疗过程中会做些什么？
column4: I'd like to ask about chemotherapy side effects.
column5: 我想咨询化疗的副作用。

column2: How long is each radiotherapy session?
column4: Can you explain the radiotherapy schedule?
column5: 能解释一下放疗的时间安排吗？

column2: What is this antibiotic called?
column3: 这种抗生素叫什么名字？
column4: I'd like to ask the pharmacist about this antibiotic.
column5: 我想向药剂师咨询这种抗生素。

column2: Is this an antiviral medicine?
column4: Please explain why an antiviral was prescribed.
column5: 请说明为什么开了抗病毒药。

column2: What type of anesthesia will be used?
column4: I'd like to ask about anesthesia risks.
column5: 我想咨询麻醉的风险。

column2: I'd like to make an appointment with a dentist.
column4: The dentist asked where it hurts.
column5: 牙医问我哪里疼。

column2: Does my insurance cover dental care?
column3: 我的保险涵盖牙科治疗吗？
column4: I've booked a dental checkup.
column5: 我预约了牙科检查。

column2: Can I speak to the surgeon?
column3: 我能和外科医生谈谈吗？
column4: The surgeon explained the procedure.
column5: 外科医生解释了手术过程。

column2: My physician referred me to a specialist.
column3: 我的内科医生把我转诊给了专科医生。
column4: I'd like to discuss this with my physician.
column5: 我想和我的内科医生讨论这件事。

column2: Is a pediatrician available today?
column4: The pediatrician asked about my child's sleep.
column5: 儿科医生询问了孩子的睡眠情况。

column2: I'd like to see a gynaecologist.
column4: My gynaecologist explained the test results.
column5: 我的妇科医生解释了检查结果。

column2: When can I see the obstetrician?
column3: 我什么时候能看产科医生？
column4: The obstetrician explained my care plan.
column5: 产科医生解释了我的诊疗计划。

column2: How can I contact my therapist?
column3: 我怎样联系我的治疗师？
column4: My therapist asked about my goals.
column5: 我的治疗师询问了我的目标。

column2: I'd like an appointment with a psychiatrist.
column3: 我想预约看精神科医生。
column4: The psychiatrist asked about my sleep.
column5: 精神科医生询问了我的睡眠情况。

column2: Can I speak to a psychologist?
column3: 我可以和心理学家谈谈吗？
column4: The psychologist explained what the session involves.
column5: 心理学家解释了这次咨询的内容。

column2: When does rehabilitation begin?
column3: 康复治疗什么时候开始？
column4: I've been referred to the rehabilitation team.
column5: 我被转诊给了康复团队。

column2: Where is the outpatient clinic?
column4: My next visit is an outpatient appointment.
column5: 我下次就诊是门诊预约。

column2: Does this require inpatient care?
column4: The hospital has an inpatient ward.
column5: 这家医院有住院病房。

column2: What do I need to bring for admission?
column4: The nurse explained the admission process.
column5: 护士解释了入院流程。

column2: When can I discuss my discharge plan?
column3: 我什么时候可以讨论出院计划？
column4: Please give me a copy of the discharge summary.
column5: 请给我一份出院小结。

column2: Do I need a referral for this appointment?
column3: 这次预约需要转诊证明吗？
column4: My doctor has sent the referral.
column5: 我的医生已经发出了转诊单。

column2: I'd like to book a checkup.
column4: What is included in the checkup?
column5: 体检包含哪些项目？

column2: Please bring your immunization record.
column3: 请带上你的免疫接种记录。
column4: Where can I ask about immunization?
column5: 我可以在哪里咨询免疫接种？

column2: Can you explain what immunity means?
column3: 能解释一下免疫力是什么意思吗？
column4: The leaflet discusses immunity after vaccination.
column5: 说明单介绍了接种后的免疫情况。

column2: I'd like to learn about the immune system.
column4: The doctor explained how the immune system works.
column5: 医生解释了免疫系统的运作方式。
